title: Toy Food Conveyor Belt Detection
description: Detect 15 types of toy food and a PSOC™ Edge AI Kit box moving on a conveyor belt.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio to detect 15 types of toy food and a PSOC™ Edge AI Kit box moving along a conveyor belt. It demonstrates real-time detection of multiple overlapping objects for industrial automation and smart manufacturing demonstrations.
